'''Broest''' was an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]], on the [[Agricultural Circuit|Ag Circuit]]. It was controlled by [[Salliche Agricultural Corporation|Salliche Ag Corporation]].
